# CHR-17 — Drag-and-drop calendar evidence

Demo of rescheduling booking blocks by drag-and-drop on the Slotcraft week calendar.

## Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `drag-drop-walkthrough.mp4` | Live walkthrough: drag "Design critique" to a new day/time, then open the panel |
| `01-login-page.png` | Login |
| `02-calendar-before-drag.png` | Before: booking on Thursday ~2 PM |
| `03-after-drag-booking-moved.png` | After first move: Friday ~9:30 AM |
| `04-booking-panel-opened.png` | Panel confirming updated times |
| `05-final-state-after-close.png` | Calendar after closing the panel |
